title: Canopy MAP kickoff — confirm stakeholders & ops bridge
text:
Canopy MAP kickoff — confirm stakeholders & ops bridge

["From: Sarah Kim <sarah@canopyhealth.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, monica_patel@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-04-18T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + MAP kickoff ask

Hi Jonas / team,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Canopy team is excited to move to a formal MAP so we can align on success criteria and close timing. We'd like a 45-minute kickoff next week to:
- Introduce internal stakeholders
- Walk through the evaluation plan and acceptance criteria
- Lock a target close milestone (goal: contract signed by end of May)

Proposed attendees from our side: Tom Alvarez (Product), Priya Menon (Security), Daniel Cho (SRE). Can you confirm the right owners on Redwood's side and propose 2 possible 45-minute slots?

Attachments: MAP_template.xlsx (please use as starting point)

Thanks,
Sarah Kim
Head of Platform Partnerships
Canopy Health
", "From: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
To: Sarah Kim <sarah@canopyhealth.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, monica_patel@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-04-18T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + MAP kickoff ask

Sarah — great to hear, thanks for the clear ask.

Quick confirm on Redwood attendees:
- Jonas Weber (Sales lead) — I'll run the kickoff and summarize the MAP
- Marissa Cole (Customer Success) — will own onboarding & eval coordination
- Monica Patel (Solutions/Activation) — will own test harness and eval runs
- Karthik Iyer (Solutions Eng) — technical lead for integration & security Qs

Two slots that work for our team:
1) Tue Apr 20, 10:30–11:15 PT
2) Wed Apr 21, 13:00–13:45 PT

I'll attach a working MAP template and a short draft agenda; if one of those times works, we'll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link.

Attachments: MAP_template.xlsx

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
", "From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@canopyhealth.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Sarah Kim <sarah@canopyhealth.ai>, Priya Menon <priya.m@canopyhealth.ai>, Daniel Cho <danielc@canopyhealth.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + MAP kickoff ask

Jonas — thanks. Wed Apr 21, 13:00 PT works best for us.

Attendees confirmed from Canopy:
- Tom Alvarez (Product)
- Priya Menon (Security)
- Daniel Cho (SRE)
- Megan Ortiz (Procurement) — may join for the final 10 minutes for timeline alignment

Evaluation priorities:
1) Latency SLO under P50/P95 for our prompt sets
2) Data isolation & key management (we need to validate KMS/HSM integration)
3) Regression checks on hallucination for our two critical flows

Target close: end of May (we have an internal Q2 procurement window). Also, Priya will ask for SOC 2 Type II evidence and a basic data flow diagram prior to the eval.

Thanks — we'll take the 13:00 PT slot.
Tom
", "From: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@canopyhealth.ai>, Sarah Kim <sarah@canopyhealth.ai>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com, monica_patel@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-04-19T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Intro + MAP kickoff ask — Agenda + ops bridge link

On Apr 18, 2027, at 10:02, jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com wrote:
> Sarah — great to hear, thanks for the clear ask.
> 
> Quick confirm on Redwood attendees:
> - Jonas Weber (Sales lead) — I'll run the kickoff and summarize the MAP
> - Marissa Cole (Customer Success) — will own onboarding & eval coordination
> - Monica Patel (Solutions/Activation) — will own test harness and eval runs
> - Karthik Iyer (Solutions Eng) — technical lead for integration & security Qs
> 
> Two slots that work for our team:
> 1) Tue Apr 20, 10:30–11:15 PT
> 2) Wed Apr 21, 13:00–13:45 PT
> 
> I'll attach a working MAP template and a short draft agenda; if one of those times works, we'll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link.
> 
> Attachments: MAP_template.xlsx
> 
> —Jonas

Hi all — adding a short agenda and ops details for Wed Apr 21, 13:00–13:45 PT (confirmed):

Draft agenda (35–45 min):
- 0–5m: Introductions & objectives (Jonas)
- 5–15m: Canopy priorities & success criteria (Tom / Sarah)
- 15–25m: Redwood evaluation plan & test matrix (Monica / Karthik)
- 25–35m: Security & compliance checklist (Marissa + Karthik)
- 35–45m: Timeline and next steps (Jonas + Megan from Canopy)

Ops bridge: Zoom link — https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=example
Calendar hold (send once invites are accepted) — https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=canopy-map-kickoff-20270421

Please review the attached MAP template and add any acceptance criteria you'd like captured during the kickoff.

Attachments referenced: MAP_template.xlsx

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
", "From: monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
To: Canopy Team <sarah@canopyhealth.ai>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@canopyhealth.ai>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-04-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: MAP kickoff calendar + prep pack

Thanks everyone — invite has been created and calendar holds will show up for the confirmed attendees.

Prep pack (short):
- Mutual Action Plan v1 (attached) — includes proposed acceptance criteria, evaluation milestones, and required evidence list
- Test harness checklist — what we'll need from Canopy to run evals (test keys, sample prompt set, expected throughput)
- Security evidence request — SOC 2 reference & SSO/KMS contact points

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v1.pdf
RSVP: Please accept the calendar invite and add any missing attendees (Megan, Priya, Daniel).

Looking forward to the kickoff on Wed Apr 21 at 13:00 PT.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Solutions/Activation, Redwood Inference
"]
